blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Media organizations on Monday renewed calls for justice for the 58 victims of the 2009 Maguindanao massacre, urging the government to resolve pending cases, arrest remaining suspects, and strengthen protections for journalists 17 years after the killings. The National Press Club (NPC), National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) and Himati, the official student publication of the University of the Philippines (UP) Mindanao, marked the anniversary by stressing that the convictions secured in 2019 had not ended the pursuit of accountability. “The fight is not yet over,” NPC president Mina Navarro said in a statement. “We call […]...
